def factor_volume_weighted_overnight_gap_v2(df):
    """Volume-weighted overnight gap: overnight return scaled by volume ratio."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    is_high, is_low, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    factor = overnight_ret * vol_ratio
    factor.name = "factor_volume_weighted_overnight_gap_v2"
    return factor
